challenges.public_brief: Fix the localized deterministic defect and preserve existing behavior.

Explain the dispatch-to-ledger-to-evaluation lifecycle with checked citations.
Synthesize a narrow question from local primary sources.
Compare agent harness techniques and separate framework facts from proposals.
Reproduce and minimally repair one deterministic defect.
Reproduce, localize, repair, and regression-test a bounded multi-file defect.
